answer: Anti-sybil via commit-reveal registration with a slashing bond and a slow intake queue. Each new agent commits a hash of its identity, waits 24 hours, then reveals it together with a 5,000 POA bond; the bond is slashed in full if the same identity material ever appears twice, and only 100 registrations clear per day, so a flood cannot outrun honest agents. An attacker wanting 10,000 fake identities must post 50,000,000 POA in bonds and wait 100 days at the queue limit, while one honest agent posts a single 5,000 POA bond and waits one day. The words are ripple, echo, sparrow.
